entries.claim: The full local digital tract has conspexerunt, unlike printed inspexerunt, and the declared spelling and punctuation differences. Its exact raw body is preserved.
The complete tract is printed separately under §7 on Benziger 1962 p. 139. Its inspexerunt and exact punctuation are retained; the preceding gradual is not part of this text.
